name: commy-file-store
description: Cloudflare Worker that keeps sealed copies of a Commy server's shared files in the owner's own R2 bucket

SETUP_CODE.description: A code of at least 16 letters, digits or dashes that you type into Commy once to connect this storage to your server. Keep it to yourself.

DAILY_UPLOAD_MB.description: How many megabytes each member may upload a day. 500 if left as is.
